# Sex and Gender

A comparison between parent report of sex at birth and parent report of child's gender at baseline data collection timepoint.

```{r}
# Parent report of gender identity
gish_p_gi <- abcd_load(
    core_path("gender-identity-sexual-health/gish_p_gi.csv")
)

sex <- get_sex(gish_p_gi, t = 0)

# Parent report of gender
pr_gender <- get_p_gender(gish_p_gi, t = 0)

sex_and_gender <- dplyr::inner_join(sex, pr_gender, by = "subjectkey")

sex_and_gender |>
    dplyr::select(-"subjectkey") |>
    table()

dim(sex_and_gender)
```

A tiny fraction of kids (10/11868) have different values between their biological sex at birth and parent report of gender.
